Q: Thanks for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you're okay to proceed?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe what happened when the collision occurred in Pearland.
A: I was driving on a two-lane road heading toward the shopping center. The other car came over into my lane and
we met head-on. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to jolt me forward and back.
Q: What was your speed at the time?
A: I'd say around thirty miles an hour, maybe a little less. I had just slowed down for a turn.
Q: Did either vehicle have airbags deploy?
A: No, nothing deployed. The cars drove away from the scene under their own power, but both had some front-end
damage.
Q: Did you get out and speak with the other driver?
A: Yes, briefly. We exchanged insurance information and waited for the police to arrive.
Q: How are you feeling physically since the accident?
A: My neck is sore and stiff, especially when I turn my head to check traffic. I also get a dull ache across my
shoulders by the end of the day.
Q: Have you sought any medical treatment?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me instructions for rest and
pain management. I have a follow-up with my primary doctor next week.
Q: Are you currently missnig any work because of your symptoms?
A: Not yet. I've been able to work from home, but I'm limiting my time at the computer because it aggravates the pain.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'll send over the urgent care paperwork when I get a chance.
Q: Tahnk you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>
